🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION ↓ falling vs XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, and VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND → flat confirm a neutral, rotational market.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear modestly lower: VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND → flat. Credit neutral: HYG (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION → flat and LQD (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND → flat. Stocks vs bonds mixed: SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION ↓ falling vs TLT (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) BELOW TREND → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) BELOW TREND → flat and LQD (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND → flat, implying slight pressure on rates/duration but no clear directional impulse.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Healthcare and Energy leading: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Tech lagging in the week: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION ↓ falling. Style: Value/cyclicals showing relative strength vs growth.

5. US vs Global?
US soft this week: SPY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION ↓ falling. Emerging markets and China lag: EEM (1W: -6.18% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and FXI (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -6.75%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation weakening: IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and ARKK (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; small caps muted: IWM (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +0.66%) CORRECTION ↓ falling.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals under pressure: GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and SLV (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Industrial metals mixed: CPER (1W: -3.53% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy shows relative strength but not uniform: XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising while BNO (1W: -1.14% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and UNG (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%) CORRECTION ↓ falling.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND show consistent strength. MAJOR DIVERGENCE present: multiple ETFs show 1W negative vs 1M positive (XLK, SOXX, CIBR, IGV) — suppress strong regime convictions and keep allocations flexible.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to sectors showing strength (XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to highly speculative ETFs (IBIT (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -20.95%) BELOW TREND, ARKK (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND); bonds remain neutral (TLT (1W: -0.99% | 1M: -0.81%) BELOW TREND).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Healthcare XLV (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +5.48%) ABOVE TREND and Energy XLE (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION and Communication/Discretionary group (Comm. 1W: -4.63% | 1M: -7.04% BELOW TREND).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -1.47% | 1M: +6.46%) CORRECTION for tactical moves. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -3.40% | 1M: -7.97%) BELOW TREND and Silver SLV (1W: -9.00% | 1M: -13.99%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX watch: VXX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -11.25%) BELOW TREND — complacency if it stays low. Credit spread watch: HYG (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.11%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -0.25%) BELOW TREND. Tech/value pivot: XLK (1W: -5.92% | 1M: +8.54%) CORRECTION vs Financials (sector 1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.55%) — monitor for confirmation.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive supporting a mixed, transitional market. Healthcare (XLV) and Energy (XLE) showing strength while Tech (XLK) and speculative ETFs (IBIT, ARKK) show weakness; monitor major 1W/1M divergences for regime tipping points.
